overclaims: AI credit spreads widened in mid-2026.
Nvidia told customers server prices would rise more than 15%, though for systems shipped in 2027.
Nvidia's 2026 bond drew about four times the demand on offer, and AI service list prices held flat into autumn 2026.
The claim is a broad compound statement, and one of its parts (patience) has no ordinary measure.
checks.note: The rationale generalizes one issuer's monthly CDS increase, states a reported and unverified server-price increase as fact, and broadens unchanged September–October prices for 17 continuing offerings to AI services generally. No patience measure was found; that does not establish that no ordinary measure exists. The outcome and evidence metadata match the frozen case.
